entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ahmed Izzet Pasha, known as Ahmet İzzet Furgaç after the Turkish Surname Law of 1934, was a Turkish-Albanian soldier and statesman. He was a general during World War I and also one of the last Grand Viziers of the Ottoman Empire and its last Minister of Foreign Affairs.
